QoreWitness Verifier

Check that a camera recording existed before a known time. Post-quantum signatures (ML-DSA-87), anchored on QoreChain. Your video stays in this browser.

Choose a file and its receipt.
    QoreChain testnet (diana, chain ID 9800). A blockchain anchor is not an eIDAS qualified timestamp. It proves the file existed at a time. It does not prove who recorded it or that the camera was honest.
